summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing a binding agreement with the Government of Rwanda (GOR) to form a tungsten platform, Almonty Rwanda Pty Ltd. Almonty will hold 75% and the GOR 25%, with the GOR contributing the ~32 km² Shyorongi exploration concession and a mobile tailings processing license; no cash consideration or per-share price is stated. The platform will aggregate ore, pre-concentrate and panning tailings from Rwandan license holders and export material pending construction of a collection and processing plant. No board recommendation or advisor is named. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K is the US-equivalent disclosure; watch permitting, funding for the plant, and whether this first stage expands into a broader investment framework.
